title: Azusawa Kohane — Trying To Stay Awake〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm back!
*Sigh*
Another day, another exhausting event!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I know it was for practice, but going to Shizuoka and back by car wasn't easy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In that sense, I'm guessing Ken's the most exhausted out of all of us...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much for driving us today. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
There's no need to thank me.
I'm taking you to all these places because I think it's necessary for your training.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Also, I like going out for long drives.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that reminds me.
Dad, you used to drive us everywhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I remember going camping in the mountains, doing a barbeque by the beach and a bunch of other stuff. A lot of good times.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That sounds like fun.
It's always nice to go to those kinds of places to get a breath of fresh air.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but where we went today also had that sort of effect. I thought what we saw was very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mount Fuji, tea fields and so much more... I had a lot of fun seeing those things from the car.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Seeing those things made me want to go sightseeing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, I guess we don't have much time for that right now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... I mean, it's still fun to talk about what we saw out the car today and stuff!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In terms of an actual trip, we can go the next time we get a chance to!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that as well.
When we do go, we'll be able to have all the fun we couldn't today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Actually, I was sort of surprised...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? By what?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always thought Shizuoka was really far away, but we went there and back in a day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you mean...
It did seem further away for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you've never driven before, those sorts of distances can be hard to judge.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be driving in the future, so you'll have a better idea of it then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Me? Driving...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I don't know if I'd be up to it...
I'd be too scared of crashing into things...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll become a safe driver after you practice at a driving school.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How long have you had your license, Ken...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I got mine as soon as I could since I've always loved motorcycles...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The first time I went for a long ride on my motorcycle was so incredible.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, traveling that far on my own felt like a huge accomplishment. It was like I'd taken a big step towards becoming an adult.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, you can all look forward to experiencing something similar in the future.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's right. Having our own means of transport would mean getting to perform at even more live houses.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...
We can even revisit all those places that gave us a chance!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... And sharing a car would be much simpling than us all riding motorcycles...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I totally agree.
We could even take turns driving to make things easier.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, none of us are old enough to start getting our licenses yet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Then, we should go get them together when we can someday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, great idea! I'd love to do that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Slow down, you two...
Keep in mind that there's a written test.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nah, Toya, what are you talking about?
We totally got this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They just ask you common-sense questions, right? It can't be that hard.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: As someone who went through that process myself, I'm telling you that you need to study for it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it'd be so great if we could drive around and travel to really far off places together someday...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We could go to Yokohama, Kyoto and... It'd almost be like a school trip.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We could do events all over, and even go camping together again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, we've taken a pretty long break now. Let's get back to practicing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we'll start again from the top while being mindful of what we discussed in the debrief.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'm all recharged and ready to go whenever!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too! Let's give it one last good effort!
